build_cuda_extension_sgutilslib: build the sgutils CUDA extension module from sg.cu using python setup.py build_ext --inplace
build_sgutils_package: build and install the sgutils package with pip install . to compile the CUDA extension
review_cuda_compile_args: review the nvcc compile flags for fast math and GPU architecture targets sm_70 sm_80 sm_86
refactor_cuda_arch_targets: refactor the CUDA extension to add or remove GPU architecture gencode targets for different hardware
summarize_setup_py: summarize the setup.py configuration for the sgutils CUDA extension package build
